main_text.p: sicut serui Dei omnes honoratè, fraternitatem diligite, Deum timete, Regem autem honorificate.] In fine autem De passione Domini. {h} Libri 3. ita demùm concludit: ] oramus autem Deum, ut aures clementiæ tuæ verbo veritatis placidas reddat, & pio cordi tuo lumen sapientiæ spiritualis infundat, ut filium Dei Dominum IESVM Christum sic honorifices sicut honorificas Patrem; meretur enim hoc à te, ut eum qui te fecit, Patre tuo meliore, Patri suo (secundū diuinam naturam) fatearis æqualem. Quęso gloriose Rex, ut in te cōsideres largitatem diuini muneris, & potestatem non minuas largitoris, ut qui tēporale donauit regnum, donet etiam sempiternum: [ Nec Aphricanæ dissimilis Ecclesia Gallicana, quæ circa idem tempus in Synodo Agathensi congregata, pro vitâ & salute Alarici Regis etiam Arriani, Deum deprecata est: ipsa vero oratio in Actorū Synodalium frontispicio reperta, ita se habet. {i} Cùm in Dei nomine, ex permissu Regis in Agathensem ciuitatem Sancta Synodus conuenifset, & in S.t Andreæ Basilica confedissemus, ibíque flexis

page.notes: Note h and note i are placed by their reference marks in the text. Note i reads "In Tom. Concil. Volum.2" with the 2 printed as a superscript. Doubtful readings: "Agathensem" (the mark over the A is uncertain), "Quęso" (the ę is uncertain), and "secundū" (the first letter is printed in a form that could also be f). The "S.t" abbreviation is printed with a superscript t. The marks h and i were read from small superscript letters in the text, and their exact placement is approximate.
